While I am in there, should I also add a \"shuffle\" order mode for variety?"},{"message_id":"m-r2-u2","role":"user","text":"Please do not add any order modes. \"order\" stays closed: only \"artist\" and \"duration\", here and everywhere."},{"message_id":"m-r2-u3","role":"user","task_handle":"build-manifest","text":"Implement build_manifest(payload) in playlist_prep.py on top of sequence_playlist. Exact behavior: recognized top-level keys are only \"tracks\", \"order\", \"allow_duplicates\", \"title\", \"gap_seconds\"; any other key follows the standing house rule before any other check. A non-object payload is handed to sequence_playlist as-is and its result returned. \"title\" is required: if absent return {\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"'title' is required\"}; if not a string return {\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"'title' must be a string\"}; clean it by stripping outer whitespace and collapsing each internal whitespace run to one space, and if blank return {\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"'title' must not be blank\"}; the cleaned title is echoed in the output. \"gap_seconds\" is optional, default 2: present but not an integer (true and false do not count) returns {\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"'gap_seconds' must be an integer\"}; a negative value returns {\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"'gap_seconds' must not be negative\"}. Then call sequence_playlist with exactly tracks, order (when present) and allow_duplicates (when present); an ok-false result is returned unchanged. Build entries from the sequenced tracks: for the artist ordering only, apply the current manifest rule — tracks by the same artist (ignoring case) are listed longest first, and equal lengths keep the sequenced relative order; the duration ordering is used exactly as sequenced. Each entry is {\"position\": 1-based, \"id\", \"title\", \"artist\", \"seconds\", \"clock\", \"start\", \"start_clock\", \"explicit\"} where \"start\" is the sum of the durations of all earlier entries plus gap_seconds once per boundary before it (first entry starts at 0) and \"start_clock\" is format_clock(start). Return {\"ok\": true, \"title\": <cleaned>, \"order\": <effective order>, \"count\", \"gap_seconds\", \"total_seconds\": durations plus gap_seconds*(count-1), or 0 when empty, \"total_clock\": format_clock(total_seconds), \"entries\"}. Do not redefine or patch the earlier functions."}]
